universities.name: Fudan University
universities.english: Only two English-taught undergraduate programs: MBBS and Economics (UIPE); other programs are taught in Chinese
universities.fields: Politics (QS subject rank 20, 2025), medical sciences, chemistry, materials science
universities.scholarships: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Government Scholarship, Fudan fellowships
universities.selective: Not published; degree application fee RMB 800

universities.name: Zhejiang University
universities.tuition: RMB 19,800–29,800 a year by discipline (RMB 42,800 for MBBS); ZJU-UIUC Institute RMB 160,000
universities.english: Some English-taught undergraduate programs (see the 2026 catalog); many programs are taught in Chinese
universities.scholarships: Chinese Government Scholarship; scholarships for selected English-taught programs

universities.name: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
universities.living: Dormitory RMB 500–1,000 a month; insurance RMB 800 a year
universities.english: Chinese-taught: HSK 5 with 60+ in each part; China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) required
universities.fields: Physics, chemistry, materials science, computer science
universities.scholarships: USTC Fellowship A: tuition, insurance, RMB 2,500 monthly stipend and housing subsidy; Level B: tuition; Chinese Government Scholarship
sources: Tuition and fees (graduate rates on this page)

universities.name: Wuhan University
universities.living: RMB 1,000–2,000 a month (Wuhan University estimate); insurance RMB 1,000 a year
universities.english: Most undergraduate programs are taught in Chinese, a few in English; applicants must be 18–25
universities.fields: Philosophy (QS subject rank 23, 2025), surveying and remote sensing
universities.scholarships: Chinese Government Scholarship and other awards — see the university’s scholarship attachments
sources: Undergraduate admissions guide for international applicants

universities.name: Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT)
universities.living: Dormitory RMB 800–1,000 a month per bed
universities.english: English-taught: Civil Engineering; Chemical Engineering and Technology (IELTS above 6.0, no band below 5.5, or TOEFL above 80). Chinese-taught: HSK 4 (210+). CSCA required
universities.fields: Aerospace, robotics, mechanical engineering, computer science
universities.scholarships: HIT International Students Scholarship; Chinese Government Scholarship

universities.name: Beijing Institute of Technology (BIT)
universities.english: English-taught programs: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 85 or Duolingo 110
universities.fields: Engineering, computer science, materials, chemistry; defense-related research
universities.scholarships: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A); Beijing Government Scholarship (A, B and C classes)
